Hello, my name is Nicole. I’m a certified canine remedial massage therapist.

We want to support dogs through mobility changes, recovery, and ageing with tailored bodywork support so families can enjoy more good days together.

This channel is a inclusive space dedicated to helping dogs feel safe, soft, and supported through bodywork. I share practical tips on canine health, mobility, acupressure points, and gentle massage techniques to help you better understand your dog’s body and comfort, especially as they age, recover, or deal with anxiety.

Find us on instagram and TikTok!
